recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, warm-toned portrait of a woman with long dark hair, wearing a textured faux-fur garment. The image features a strong golden-yellow light leak from the right and a sharp geometric white triangular overlay on the left, creating a modern, high-contrast composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm golden light vs. cool white geometric shapes
Soft organic hair/fur textures vs. sharp typographic lines
Subject's direct gaze vs. asymmetrical layout
Dark hair and makeup vs. high-key background
coreInvariants: Golden-yellow lens flare effect on the right side
White triangular graphic element in the upper left
Subject wearing a textured, light-colored fur or shag coat
High-contrast dark lipstick and defined eyebrows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, framed from the chest up, filling approximately 80% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the dark eyes and lips, serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-left text, down the diagonal of the white triangle to the face, then across the light flare to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High-key white space in the upper left and bright flare in the lower right provide breathing room for text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) with selective high saturation in the yellow flare; low saturation in the skin tones.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Wide tracking for the secondary title
Tight but non-touching kerning for the primary name

composition.relationshipToImage: Anchors the base of the composition
Balances the top of the frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different scales and tracking values for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Diagonal white color block in upper left
Soft-edged yellow gradient overlay on right

preserve: High-contrast dark color against light background

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, geometric, and modern feel of the primary text.
Provides the same circular geometry and clean terminals.
Classic geometric choice that fits the uppercase aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key portrait of a woman with long dark hair and dark lipstick, wearing a white faux-fur coat. Apply a sharp white diagonal triangle in the top left corner and a soft golden-yellow sun flare/light leak coming from the right side. The overall background should be bright and slightly overexposed.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a geometric sans-serif font like Montserrat, add the primary name in large uppercase at the bottom, and the title in smaller uppercase with wide tracking in the top left corner. Use a deep chocolate brown or black for the text color.

verificationChecks: Is the light flare distinctly yellow/golden?
Is the top-left triangle sharp and pure white?
Is the typography a clean, modern sans-serif?
Does the subject have high-contrast makeup (dark lips/eyes)?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the yellow light leak
Angle of the white geometric overlay
Texture density of the fur garment
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the celebrity
Any trademarked logos or specific brand names
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the background
Check that the yellow flare doesn't obscure the eyes
Verify the white triangle has a clean, hard edge
Confirm the color palette remains warm and bright
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key portrait + diagonal geometric overlay + warm light leak + geometric sans-serif typography
